findings.explanation: A signed-in user who is not an admin can call the function "admin_grant_credits", which runs with more rights than the caller.
findings.fix: Make "admin_grant_credits" admin-only: run REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public."admin_grant_credits" FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated; and call it only from your server, or check inside the function that the caller is an admin and raise an error if not.

notes: These tests could not run, so this result does not cover them: user updates rows on "app_admins". Do not read this result as a clean one.
